enchantments.tooltip: Smoke Screen: You are surrounded by wisps of concealing smoke, giving opponents a 20% concealment chance to miss you.
Immunity to Fear: The wearer of this item is immune to all fear effects.
Healing Amplification: This effect amplifies all incoming positive energy healing by +53 (Competence bonus). Includes spells, potions, and other effects.
Sheltering +33: +33 Enhancement bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings
Armor Bonus +13: This item surrounds the wearer with an invisible but tangible field of force, granting +13 armor bonus to AC, just as though he were wearing armor.
